regime_note: TAKE-ALL regime from 2026-09-02: every candidate that passes the gates is tracked as a position (up to max_concurrent), not only the top-ranked one. Rank order is kept solely for the cap and the archive. Gates, exits and thresholds are UNCHANGED from 1.0.0.

entry.min_filter_score_comment: UW PRIORITY threshold. With require_strong_leg ON, this is a priority (UW>=3 picked first), NOT a hard gate — best tradeable candidate fires even at UW<3.

selection.take_all_comment: 2026-09-02 (user decision). Four independent tests showed the one-per-day pick has NO skill and the skipped names carried the return (clean universe: PICKED R +0.023 vs SKIPPED +0.518; take-all Sharpe-ish ~16x). So every candidate that passes the gates is tracked, in rank order, until open+new reaches max_concurrent (=6 covers 94% of days; median 2 open). SIZE EACH AT 1/max_concurrent OF THE BOOK — this spreads the same risk, it does not multiply it. Set take_all_qualified=false to revert to top-only.
selection.skew_noise_comment: DATA-QUALITY gate (earned by SMMT 6/9). If structural skew std-dev over the last 6 trading days > this, the options chain is too noisy/thin to trust — NO TRADE regardless of legs. Validated: all 8 real trades had skew_std <=12; SMMT-noise = 30.
selection.comment: THE GATE (earned by SYM+RGTI losses, both weak-on-both). TRADEABLE only if >=1 strong leg: structural skew <= strong_skew_max (deep capitulation) OR vol-adjusted cushion >= strong_vol_cushion_min (cushion% / (ATM_IV/sqrt252) daily-moves). Weak on BOTH = NO TRADE even if it cleared the mechanical Tier A screen. Among tradeable: UW>=3 priority, else best by leg strength. Validated 7/8 vs history (only AR — weakest win, corrupt put-wall data — would've been skipped).

exits.bot_auto_close_at_comment: Bot's default exit is TP1. T2/T3 noted in post for traders holding longer at own discretion.

uw_pulls.options_volume_days_back_comment: Only need ~15 days for z-score + OI evolution. 20 = small buffer. Override via CLI --vol-days for backtests on older dates.
uw_pulls.darkpool_days_back_comment: 10 trading days before entry day, used for cumulative block count + slope.

change_log.rationale: research_uw_picker_v1 baseline, no prospective data yet

1 was a test/loose setting left in by mistake; it alerted INTU on only 1/4 UW conditions (flow contradicting the thesis) and broadcast it to X with the full Bonferroni claim. 3 requires >=3 of 4 UW conditions to confirm, matching the research edge. Only exceptional, flow-confirmed setups now fire.

The one-per-day pick has no measured skill (tiebreaker spearman +0.035; skipped > picked on 8/17 and again on 9/02 clean: PICKED R +0.023 vs SKIPPED +0.518, p=0.908; no entry metric separates winners from losers on 14 live or 43 historical). The edge is the screen, not the choosing, so discarding ~60% of qualified names was throwing away return. Take-all at equal weight raised Sharpe-ish ~16x with LOWER volatility. Gates, exits, thresholds unchanged. Cap 6 covers 94% of days (median 2 open). Position size = 1/6 of book. Also triples the learning sample.
